key_idea: Sort and pair the heaviest remaining bag with the lightest one if they fit together, otherwise send the heaviest alone.
sketch: Sort weights; two pointers i (lightest) and j (heaviest). Each trip takes w[j]; if i<j and w[i]+w[j] <= m also take w[i]. Exchange argument: if the heaviest cannot pair with the lightest it pairs with nothing, and if it can, pairing with the lightest never hurts. O(n log n) with n = 5e5. Sum of two weights reaches 2e9, so use 64-bit.
